savedPixelReferenceExperiments.variant: longer baseline after sustained recent fallback

changes: Strict broad replay requires the existing strong-recovery strip criteria for global corrections, including transported proposals. Ambiguous refinement cannot fall back to an unrefined proposal. Legacy sparse loop closure remains unchanged outside broad mode. Host GPU result capacity follows accepted output count, avoiding large allocations for rejected search candidates.
Throwaway warm-up explicitly exercises feature recovery and tiered JIT. Recovery caches row queries and reuses candidate scratch space without changing rankings.
Sparse abrupt matches receive an additional broad two-axis uniqueness check before bypassing continuity clamping; repeated-pattern and masked-image regressions cover rejection.
Exact CUDA target moments avoid repeated patch scans; saturated costs stop early. Exact SSE2 SAD accelerates CPU feature matching with scalar fallback.

Calibration is separated from registration coordinates and correction round trips are tested. Bidirectional subpixel registration is under saved-prefix validation; sparse-promotion restrictions were rejected after replay regressions. CPU feature scoring rejects candidates only after their partial error cannot beat the incumbent; compact CUDA batches preserve source/sample order while removing redundant coordinate uploads.
Trusted texture recovery precedes provisional matches; bounded GPU uploads reuse validated sample layouts only for matching dimensions and source count.
A latest-verified image provides an additional texture fallback only after durable/recent search fails, retaining full search and majority checks and participating in state rollback.
Independent broad texture consensus can authorize bounded abrupt camera motion on the same frame, with explicit quality and distinct-frame checks; weak matches retain deferred verification.
CUDA rejects mathematically impossible majority candidates early, preserving surviving scores and full search coverage; exact-boundary CPU/GPU tests passed.
Sparse low-error anchors are checked against a larger independent recent consensus before reference promotion; a synthetic foreground-strip regression verifies the decision.
Controlled simulation commands with acknowledged delta; camera follows recorded hero, no camera truth sent to tracker.
Room mask FSM states, variables and sprite alpha are retained by both checkpoint codecs; missing objects/state names reject restore.
Enemy restore no longer resets all semi-persistent room objects; camera SnapTo no longer overwrites the saved target.
Unchanged mask state actions continue across boundaries; checkpoint socket tests exercise payloads larger than 4 KiB.
Exact rendered pixels joined with their own live telemetry; simulation waits for frame scoring before advancing.
Separate controlled-session pointer preserves older wall-clock journals.
Dense independent patch consensus uses one calibrated ground-plane scale across reference changes; original normal-game sparse policy retained.
CUDA reuses host staging arrays as well as device buffers; host staging allocation regression passed on the GTX 1080.
Capture waits during reconstruction and between requested controlled frames, reducing unused pixel allocations.
Reusable candidate-sample storage and stack scratch space reduce CPU allocation during broad search and subpixel fitting.
CPU search setup reuses per-row source validity masks and candidate storage; 100-fixture parity and bounded-allocation regressions verify behavior and reuse.
After sustained recent-reference fallback, a longer overlapping baseline reduces accumulated subpixel drift; global correction cancels retention of pre-correction references.
Spatially separated fine subpixel consensus separates foreground parallax from ground motion, with held-out validation before acceptance.
When floor registration fails, a full two-axis CUDA texture search can register remaining walls; competing peaks receive subpixel validation, and flat or masked images are rejected.
Per-stage timing separates camera setup, aggregate GPU searches, consensus, subpixel refinement, feature matching and atlas maintenance; reports include GC counts.

rejectedExperiments.method: allow sparse promotion when prior velocity agrees

limits: Checkpoints do not serialize every Unity FSM, animation, or camera smoothing internal.
Older recordings omitted room-mask state. This run reconstructs Secret Mask Top from original image evidence; other unrecorded initial world state is not known.
In-flight mask fades restart a saved state action from saved alpha when restoration is needed; this is not a bit-identical full-process snapshot.
Unscaled effects can run during paused capture waits; later renders retain their own frame IDs and actual truth.
Inputs are sampled at tick starts; sub-tick taps are quantized. Hero poses interpolate at tick endpoints.
Accepted prefix reconstruction validates accuracy untimed; original acceptance timings remain in immutable reports.
